name: Type 95 Kurogane scout car
blurb: Japan's compact four-wheel-drive command and reconnaissance car, now a moving target on the Gunnery Range.
history: The Type 95 was a compact four-wheel-drive scout and command car built by Tokyu Kurogane Industries for the Imperial Japanese Army. Introduced in the mid-1930s, it carried three people and used an air-cooled V-twin engine. Its light liaison and reconnaissance role makes it the Japanese counterpart to the American Willys jeep in this game's vehicle roster.
